Name: Vassago's Emblem
Basic Side: When an air units wins combat, give the next air unit -1 power on their priority check
Condition: If 4 Unkengeister are in the exhaust zone at once: Transform Vassago
Ultimate Side: All of your Unkengeister have now the ability to choose an enemy ability in their exhaust zone that fits to their Tier level and use it as their own during combat. Any enemy unit's ability being copied cannot escape the exhaust zone until the cycle ends.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Glasya-Labolas's Emblem
Basic Side: If an air unit touches the ball before a "PLAY MAKER" session, give them +1 power during combat
Condition: If 4 Unkengeister have used "cold touch" on the ball: Transform Glasya-Labolas
Ultimate Side: Your Unkengeister can now possess any structure, element or object that has been added to the field. When the enemy interacts with the possessed objects, they are terrified and don't gain the benefits of that interaction one time. Cannot possess the same object multiple times in one cycle.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.

Name: Caim's Emblem
Basic Side: If an air unit swaps position of the same Tier with another air unit during combat, give the enemy unit -1 power
Condition: If 4 Unkengeister have summoned gravestones: Transform Caim
Ultimate Side: Spawn gravestones onto the soccer field, when the soccer ball knocks them over, spawn a ghost attaching it to the ball. The next Unkengeister gets +1 power for each ghost counter on the ball. After combat remove all ghost counters from the ball.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.
